name: solar-system-united-nations
title: 太阳系联合国
author: 虚无群友
description:
太阳系联合国多人场景。领取离线也会累积的低保，以科技瓶建立信用与等级；购买、续期并命名采用自然星球地形样本的私人房产，通过个人关联箱转运物资，并建造有寿命限制的个人飞船。界面支持简体中文与英文。

Solar System United Nations is a multiplayer scenario with lazily accrued offline UBI, science-pack credit and levels, tradable private properties sampled from natural planetary terrain, personal linked-chest logistics, and limited-lifetime player ships. The interface supports Simplified Chinese and English.
